prompts.prompt: Build a fruit picker where users choose both a fruit and a ripeness level in one control. The closed control should show the current choice. When opened, it should be easy to move across ripeness levels and move down to the same ripeness for the next fruit using the keyboard.
Create a date range picker for booking a hotel stay. Users should pick check-in and check-out dates. Past dates should be disabled.
Build an onboarding flow: welcome screen → profile setup → preferences → done
Something like Stripe's pricing table but with monthly/annual toggle

Build a terms and conditions acceptance form. Show a scrollable text area with the terms, then checkboxes for "I agree to the Terms of Service" and "I agree to the Privacy Policy". The continue button should only enable when both are checked.
A table of users with sortable columns and search
Navigation that collapses to hamburger on mobile
Build a support ticket form with a subject line input, a description text area with character count, and a priority selector. Submit should post to /api/tickets.
Create a product detail page with breadcrumb navigation showing Home > Category > Subcategory > Product Name. The page should have a header, product info section, and a back button.
Create a profile card with the user's name as a heading, their role as a label, their bio as body text, and their join date in small supporting text
